name: hpa
description: Per-tab map of what data lives on each Human Protein Atlas per-gene page. Tells you WHERE the protein-level (IHC / mass-spec) evidence lives vs the mRNA-level (nTPM) evidence per tab. Use BEFORE building any HPA scraper or choosing which tab to point a user at for a given evidence claim. Also documents the whole-catalog normal-tissue-IHC bulk seed, canonical download URLs (with the stale-path 404 trap), the cache row shape, and bulk-vs-OmniPath-vs-scrape supplier tradeoffs.
author: GuildOS
